university: The University of Texas at Tyler

leaders.notes: Second president of UT Tyler; served 17 years (1981-1998), the person in office in 1996. Died in 2010.

leaders.priorTitle: Dean, College of Business Administration
leaders.nextRoleInstitution: The University of Texas at Tyler
leaders.notes: Third president; served 1998-2016 (18 years). Was dean of business at the University of Tulsa 1994-1998; earlier a finance professor/chair at Clemson. Named president emeritus in 2020.

leaders.priorTitle: Dean, College of Business
leaders.notes: Fourth president, took office Jan. 1, 2017; served through the Jan. 4, 2021 merger transition when Calhoun took over the combined institution. Previously dean of Eastern Michigan University's College of Business (since 2012).

leaders.priorTitle: President, UT Health Science Center at Tyler
leaders.priorInstitution: UT Health Science Center at Tyler
leaders.nextRoleInstitution: University of North Texas Health Science Center at Fort Worth
leaders.notes: Fifth president; took office Jan. 4, 2021 to lead the unified UT Tyler / UT Health Science Center at Tyler institution, having been president of UTHSC-Tyler since 2002. Retired May 2024; became interim president of UNT Health Science Center effective Feb. 1, 2025.

leaders.priorTitle: Executive Vice President for Health Affairs and Vice Provost
leaders.priorInstitution: The University of Texas at Tyler
leaders.notes: Sixth president and first woman to lead UT Tyler; took office June 1, 2024. A pulmonologist, she had been EVP for Health Affairs after the 2021 merger and helped launch the UT Tyler School of Medicine.

university: The University of Texas Medical Branch at Galveston

leaders.priorTitle: Chairman, Department of Medicine
leaders.nextRoleInstitution: The University of Texas Medical Branch at Galveston
leaders.notes: President 1987-1997, the person in office in 1996. A prominent cardiologist (past president of the American Heart Association); had chaired the Department of Medicine at UAB from 1973. Retired from UTMB in 2004; died 2010.

leaders.priorTitle: Director, Department of Medicine / Vice President, Johns Hopkins Health System
leaders.nextRole: Executive Vice President for Health Sciences and Services (UC Health)
leaders.nextRoleInstitution: University of California (Office of the President)
leaders.notes: President 1997-2007. Came from Johns Hopkins, where he was the William Osler Professor and director of the Department of Medicine and later a VP of the health system. Named president emeritus in 2008; became EVP for UC Health.

leaders.priorTitle: Associate Vice Chancellor and CEO, UCLA Health System
leaders.notes: President Sept. 2007-2019. A head and neck surgeon; had been CEO of UCLA Health (2004-2007). Left to become president and CEO of Memorial Hermann Health System effective Sept. 1, 2019.

leaders.priorTitle: Senior Vice President for Health Policy and Legislative Affairs
leaders.priorInstitution: The University of Texas Medical Branch at Galveston
leaders.notes: Named interim president Aug. 2019 after Callender's departure, then had the interim title dropped and became permanent president. A longtime UTMB physician-administrator. Placed on administrative leave and resigned in Aug. 2022.

leaders.priorTitle: Chairman, Department of Internal Medicine
leaders.notes: President and CEO of UTMB Health System; began Aug. 15, 2023. Previously chair of internal medicine at Rush University Medical Center in Chicago.

university: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley

leaders.priorTitle: President
leaders.notes: Founding president of UTRGV; named May 2014, led the new institution that opened in fall 2015. A sociolinguist, he was immediately prior the president of the University of Alabama, and earlier president of Texas Tech and chancellor of UMKC. Still in office in 2025.

leaders.priorTitle: Acting President / senior administrator, University of Akron
leaders.notes: 14th president, 1996-1999; the person in office in 1996. Had served as acting president from 1992. Died in 2014.

leaders.priorTitle: Vice President for Research and Dean of the Graduate School
leaders.nextRole: President Emeritus / University Professor (returned to teaching)
leaders.notes: 15th president, 1999-June 30, 2014. Earlier served at the University of Alaska (VP academic affairs and research) and Purdue University. Remained as a tenured University Professor after his presidency.

leaders.priorTitle: Provost and Executive Vice President for Academic Affairs
leaders.notes: 16th president, July 1, 2014; resigned in 2016 after a tumultuous two-year tenure. Had been provost at the University of Toledo since 2012.

leaders.priorTitle: Dean, School of Law
leaders.notes: 17th president; named interim president July 2016, made permanent Oct. 2016; resigned 2018. Had been dean of the UA School of Law (2014-2016) and earlier a dean at Temple University's Japan campus. Later became president of Missouri Western State University, then president/dean of Temple University Japan.

leaders.priorTitle: Dean, Buchtel College of Arts & Sciences (and director, Bliss Institute of Applied Politics)
leaders.nextRole: Returned to faculty / Bliss Institute of Applied Politics
leaders.notes: Interim president, effective May 1, 2018, until Gary Miller took office Oct. 1, 2019. A noted political scientist and director of the Bliss Institute.

leaders.priorTitle: Chancellor
leaders.notes: 18th president, Oct. 1, 2019 to May 15, 2024. Had been chancellor of UW-Green Bay since 2014.

leaders.priorTitle: Dean, College of Business
leaders.notes: 19th president; took office May 15, 2024. Had been dean of the UA College of Business since 2022.

leaders.priorTitle: Provost and Vice President for Academic Affairs and Research
leaders.notes: President July 15, 1991-June 30, 2007, the person in office in 1996. A physicist; had been provost at West Virginia University (1985-1991) and earlier dean at Indiana University. Died in 2019.

leaders.priorTitle: Vice Provost for Research and Professor of Materials Science
leaders.notes: Fifth president, July 1, 2007-March 31, 2011. A materials scientist who spent 31 years at Lehigh University. Left to become dean of engineering at Ohio State (2011-2021).

leaders.priorTitle: Chancellor
leaders.notes: Interim president April 1-Oct. 30, 2011, between Williams and Altenkirch, while serving as UA System Chancellor.

leaders.priorTitle: President
leaders.notes: President Sept. 21, 2011-June 21, 2019. Had been president of the New Jersey Institute of Technology (2003-2011).

leaders.priorTitle: Dean of Engineering
leaders.notes: President June 21, 2019-Nov. 30, 2021. Previously dean of engineering at Kansas State University and earlier a department chair at Clemson.

leaders.priorTitle: Dean, College of Engineering
leaders.notes: 10th president; named interim president Dec. 1, 2021 and made permanent Sept. 16, 2022. Had been dean of engineering at The University of Alabama (26 years there). ACTIVE PRESIDENTIAL SEARCH: Karr announced (Oct. 13, 2025) he will retire in May 2026; the UA System launched a national search and no successor has yet been named.
